title: Old Farmer (peds) - low-poly concept + model + Blender rig
plan: 1. Creative Claw generate_image: low-poly faceted concept of an old male farmer, A-POSE (arms down at sides, legs clearly separated so the rig can bend them), wearing overalls, work boots, a green hat and work gloves. External/full-body view, modern-day workwear, plain unpatterned colours.
2. Meshy image-to-3D on that concept -> textured GLB, model_type='smart-topology', ai_model='meshy-t2'.
3. Blender rig (Mixamo Addon, RIG_TYPE=human) - FREE, zero credits: import the GLB, build/apply the humanoid skeleton, export FBX with path_mode='COPY' and embed_textures=True.
4. Export Unity-ready FBX at 1 Unit = 1 Meter, plus Walk / Run animation clips so the ped animates in Unity 6 Mecanim.
5. Report progress via /api/update-asset-request, mark done with item_id=peds_old_farmer, then run update_catalog_readme.py.

cost.note: Rigging is free. Only the concept image (Creative Claw) and the 3D model (Meshy, ~15 credits) are paid.
cost.creative_claw: UNKNOWN - no balance recorded in assets/creative_claw_balance.json (empty). Creative Claw is reached only via the MCP connector, so the exact cost is unresolvable from here and must be confirmed by the MCP connector's estimate_generation at spend time.
